description: System Name must match across the assist letter/STC, the application letter, and the PMA supplement.
findingText: The System Name does not match across all three documents (assist letter or STC, application letter paragraph 1 or table, and PMA supplement).
resolutionHint: Reconcile the System Name so the assist letter/STC, the application letter, and the supplement agree.
limitations: Compares recorded values only; it cannot determine which document holds the correct name.
citationNote: Cites the form/procedure by role; the tenant profile supplies its own controlled document number and revision when the finding is rendered.
